patch_description: All prior programs plateau at ~0.02 normalized min-area, and all rely on single-point stochastic perturbation or per-parameter numeric gradients — too weak to coordinate all 26 coordinates jointly. The key insight exploited here: the score is scale-invariant, so if we rescale the configuration to unit hull area each step, the score equals the raw minimum triangle area, and we can directly ascend a smooth soft-min (LogSumExp) surrogate of the minimum triangle area using exact analytic gradients over all 26 coordinates simultaneously (Adam). Per-triangle area gradients ∂area/∂A,∂B,∂C are computed vectorized and aggregated with softmax weights w_t ∝ exp(-p·a_t); the sharpening parameter p anneals so the surrogate converges to the true min. Each step rescales points to unit hull area, making the smooth objective a faithful proxy of the true score. Eight diverse structured seeds (13-gon, ellipse, two-arc clusters, superellipse rounded square, spiral, double ring, 12-ring+center, perturbed polygon) — all valid by construction — are optimized under a deterministic time budget, followed by an exact hill-climb polish with bottleneck-triangle-directed moves. Exact score bookkeeping guarantees we never return worse than any visited configuration, and a fallback regular 13-gon covers any failure.
